chapter.verse: Sanhedrin uliante tangtak a et kawmin Paul in, “Sanggamte aw, tuni ciangdong Pasian' mai-ah kitheihtawmna lungsim hoihtak tawh ka nungta hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin siampi lianpenpa Ananias in Paul' gei-a a dingte' kiangah Paul' muk a bet nadingun thupia hi.

Paul in siampi lianpenpa' kiangah, “Nang, leikang kizut kulh kawmpang aw, Pasian in nang hong beeng ta ding hi. Thukhun tawh kizui-in thu hong khen dinga a tu hinapi-in thukhun tawh kilehbulhin kei hong kibet nading thupia ding na hi hiam?” ci hi.
Paul' gei-a a dingte in, “Pasian' siampi lianpenpa zahko ngam na hi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Paul in, “Sanggamte aw, amah siampi lianpenpa ahihlam a theilo ka hi hi. A hang pen ‘Na mite sunga ulianpa a sia lamin na gen kei ding uh hi,’ ci-in kigelh hi,” ci hi.

Tu-in Paul in uliante khen khat Sadducee-te, khen khat Pharisee-te ahihlam a theihcian ciangin Sanhedrin mai-ah kiko-in, “Sanggamte aw, kei pen Pharisee mi, Pharisee' suan ka hi hi. Tuni-a no teng' mai-ah thusit ka thuakna pen misite' thawhkik ding ka lametna hang ahi hi,” ci hi.
Tua a cih ciangin Pharisee-te leh Sadducee-te' kikal ah thu kiselna piang a, kikhawm mipi kikhenkham uh hi.
A hang pen Sadducee-te in thawhkikna om lo, vanmi om lo, kha om lo ci uh a, ahih hangin Pharisee-te in tuate a vekin sang uh hi.

Tua ciangin kitotna nakpi piang a, Pharisee pawlke pan laisiamte kimkhat dingto-in khauhtak thusung uh a, “Hih mipa' tungah khialhna khat zong ka mu kei uh hi. Kha khatpeuh, vanmi khatpeuh in a hopih nahi mawk leh bangci hih ding?” ci uh hi.

Thu kiselna a huaisiat ciangin tul-uk mangpa in Paul a kibalzan gawp khak ding lunghimawh ahih manin mite lakpan thatang tawh Paul a tuahkhia dingin leh galkap len ah Paul a paipih dingin galkapte a va paisuk nading thupia hi.
Tua ni zanin Paul' gei-ah Topa hong dingin ama' kiangah, “Kihangsak in. A hang pen Jerusalem khua ah keima' thu khauhtakin teci na pan dan lianin Rome khua ah zong teci na pang lai ding hi,” ci hi.
Khuavak ciangin Jew mite in sawmsim khat nei uh a, Paul thah zawh mateng anne tuidawn lo dingin amau teng mah kiciamna khat bawl uh hi.
Hih sawmsimna ah mi sawmli val kihel uh hi.
Siampi liante leh makaite' kiangah amaute pai uh a, “Paul ka thahzawh mateng uh anletui ciam vet lo ding ci-in ko teng in kiciamna khat ka bawl khin uh hi.

Tua hi a, tu-in no makaipawl in Paul' thu a kicianzaw-in a sittel ding bang khatin tul-uk mangpa zasak unla, Paul hong paipihsuk ding gen un. Paul hong naih ma-in a that dingin ka kiging uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Paul' sanggamnu' tapa in amaute' kikup galguk panna vai a zak ciangin va pai-in galkap len ah lutin Paul' kiangah gen hi.
Paul in za-uk bute khat samin, “Tul-uk mangpa' kiangah hih tangvalpa va paipih in. Amah in gen ding thu khat nei hi,” ci hi.
Za-uk bupa in tangvalpa samin tul-uk mangpa' kiangah paipih a, “Thongkiapa Paul in kei hong samin hih tangvalpa nang' kiangah paipih ding hong thum hi. Amah in gen ding thu khat hong nei hi,” ci hi.
Tul-uk mangpa in a khut lenin amah kia paikhiatpih a, “Nong gen ding thu bang ahi hiam?” ci hi.
Tangvalpa in, “Jew mite Paul' thu a cingzaw-in a dongtel ding dan khatin zingciang makaipawl' kiangah Paul na paipih nading nang hong thum dingin kithukim khin uh hi.

Ahih hangin amau' deihna zui kei in. Paul thahzawh mateng ne lo dawn lo dinga amaumah a kiciam mi sawmli val in lamkal ah Paul galguk pan sawm uh hi. Tu-in amaute a kigingsa uh hi a, nang' thukimna bek a ngak uh ahi hi,” ci hi.
Tul-uk mangpa in, “Hih thute kei nong gen lam kuamah theisak kei in,” ci-in a vaikhak khit ciangin thangvalpa ciahsak hi.
Tua ciangin tul-uk mangpa in za-uk bute nih sam a, “Nitak nai kua ciangin Caesarea dong a pai dingin galkap zanih, sakoltuang sawmsagih, teitawi zanih na kiging un.
Paul' tuan nading gante zong pia unla, gam-uk mangpa Felix' kiangah amah bittak tunpih un,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin hih bang dan laikhak khat gelh hi:
“Zahtak-huai Felix Mangpa aw, Claudius Lysias in kong hopih hi.
Hih mipa Jew mite in manin a thah ding laitakun galkapte tawh amau' kiangah ka tung a, Rome gammi ahihlam ka theih ciangin ka honkhia hi.
Amah a mawhsakna thu uh thei nuam ka hih manin amaute' makaipawl mai-ah ka paipihsuk hi.
Amau' thukhun dung zui-in a mawhsak uh hi bek a, sihna leh kolbulh khaukhih thuak nading zah thu hi peuhmah lo cih ka mukhia hi.
Tu-in hih mipa suam sawmna om cih hong kikoh ciangin nangma' kiangah kong puak pah a, amah a mawhsakte' kiangah zong amau' mawhsakna thu nangma' mai-ah hong gen nading uh ka vaikhak khin hi.”
Tua ciangin galkapte in thupiakna a ngah uh tungtawnin Paul sam uh a, zan hunin Antipatris khua paipih uh hi.
A zingciangin galkapte len ah kilehkik uh a, sakoltuangte Paul tawh paisuaksak uh hi.
Amau teng Caesarea a tun uh ciangin gam-uk mangpa' kiangah laikhak ap uh a, Paul zong va lak uh hi.
Laikhak a sim khit ciangin gam-uk mangpa in bang gamke pan Paul hong pai cih dong hi. Cilicia gamke pan ahihlam a theih ciangin
mangpa in, “Nang hong mawhsakte hong tun ciangin na thu kong ngai ding hi,” ci hi. Tua ciangin Herod' mang innpi ah Paul a kicin nadingin thupia hi.Caesarea ah Felix leh Paul
